limitations: No source checked establishes all-US survivorship-free completeness.
Historical OEF roster is fixed as of2015-06-30 and publicly known by2015-09-02; it is not historical dynamic full-market membership.
Unavailable names remain in declared101-share denominator; dropping their history induces residual coverage/survivorship bias.
Final observable bar is not automatically a tradable known-ahead exit or complete delisting return.
Spinoffs, cash-and-stock mergers, rights and distribution timing need explicit treatment.
Common-share classes are distinct; GOOG and GOOGL require issuer exposure limits.
Use NYSE trading sessions and America/New_York dates; no calendar-day target offsets or Chinese A-share limits/lots.
